battle.name: 西班尼亞的滅亡與淪陷
battle.brief: 553至555年，查士丁尼一世著手西班尼亞的滅亡與淪陷：帝國軍在瓜達萊特河畔以重裝步兵方陣與翼騎兵擊潰哥特與柏柏爾聯軍，隨後平定貴族叛亂，末代西哥特王提奧德里克死於卡爾卡松，王國就此解體。斯巴達長矛雖早於戰役七百年退場，其密集結陣、以盾推壓的方陣邏輯，是這場戰爭步兵對抗的骨架。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰雙方是東羅馬帝國與西哥特王國。帝國方面，查士丁尼一世以「恢復羅馬世界」為名，於533年出兵南高盧，先取卡爾卡松，再奪納博訥，把塞普提馬尼亞收入版圖；其後用七年時間清除東哥特殘部，再把戰火燒回西班尼亞。帝國遠征軍以羅馬化的重裝步兵為骨幹，輔以阿蘭人、赫魯利人等雇傭兵，以及重甲騎兵與弓騎兵，指揮由皇帝總攬、戰場由特使與將領率領，並以《敕令第十三》拉攏哥特貴族。西哥特一方自418年在高盧南部立足，統治伊比利亞半島大部與南高盧，首都先後在土魯斯與托萊多；王權與地方貴族議會長期互相牽制，末期幼王即位更使軍權旁落。哥特貴族中的一部分投向帝國，另一部分聯合北非的柏柏爾部族與東哥特流亡者，組成聯軍抵抗帝國。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Eastern Roman Empire and the Visigothic Kingdom. On the imperial side, Justinian I of Constantinople, pursuing the restoration of the Roman world, moved into southern Gaul in 533, took Carcassonne first and then Narbonne, and folded Septimania into the empire; he then spent seven years clearing out the Ostrogothic remnants before turning the war back against Hispania. The imperial expeditionary army was built around Romanised heavy infantry, supported by Alan, Herulian and other foederati, and by armoured cavalry and mounted archers. Command was centralised in the emperor, the field army was led by envoys and generals, and the Gothic aristocracy was courted through Edict XIII. On the Visigothic side, the kingdom had settled in southern Gaul in 418 and governed most of the Iberian peninsula together with southern Gaul, its capital moving from Toulouse to Toledo; crown and local aristocratic council long checked each other, and in the final phase the accession of a child king left real power in other hands. Part of the Gothic nobility went over to the empire, while another part joined the Berber tribes of North Africa and the Ostrogothic exiles to form a coalition against it.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩個王國。帝國一方：查士丁尼一世自527年起以整頓帝國財政、軍制與司法為樞紐，533年藉口收復失地發動戰爭，並在548至554年間用敕令與金錢分化哥特貴族；貝利撒留指揮533至534年的高盧戰役，以圍城器械攻下卡爾卡松，隨後奪取納博訥與塞普提馬尼亞；納爾塞斯於552年先在塔吉納、繼在蒙斯拉克塔里烏斯擊滅東哥特王國，使西哥特人失去最重要的外援。教宗維吉里烏斯在536至537年於羅馬與西哥特人達成妥協，為帝國爭取到教會方面的配合。西哥特一方：最後一位國王提奧德里克於551年即位，年幼受制於叔父與貴族；552年親政的阿塔納里克被推翻後，貴族馬丁及其兄弟接受帝國金援，於554年發動叛變，奪取南高盧大片土地，卻在555年的宮廷政變中被殺。據約爾丹尼斯記載，柏柏爾出身的哥特將領納瓦雷塞在這場內鬥中扮演關鍵角色；末代王提奧德里克則在555年死於卡爾卡松，普羅科匹烏斯記載傳聞說他被查士丁尼派來的使者毒殺。
peopleEn: The key figures straddle two kingdoms. On the imperial side: Justinian I, emperor from 527, made the reform of the empire's finances, army and law his instrument, went to war in 533 on the pretext of recovering lost provinces, and between 548 and 554 used decrees and gold to divide the Gothic nobility. Belisarius commanded the Gallic campaign of 533 to 534, storming Carcassonne with siege works and then taking Narbonne and Septimania. Narses destroyed the Ostrogothic kingdom in Italy in 552, first at Taginae and then at Mons Lactarius, removing the Visigoths' most important foreign support. Pope Vigilius reached an accommodation with the Visigoths at Rome in 536 and 537, winning church backing for the empire. On the Visigothic side: the last king, Theodoric, took the throne in 551 while still a boy and remained in the hands of his uncles and the nobles; Athanaric, who took personal rule in 552, was overthrown, and the noble Martin and his brothers, bought off with imperial gold, rebelled in 554 and seized much of southern Gaul, only to be killed in a palace coup in 555. Jordanes records that Navarrese, a Gothic general of Berber descent, played a decisive part in that internal strife, while the last king Theodoric died at Carcassonne in 555, Procopius noting the rumour that he was poisoned by envoys sent by Justinian.
kits: 本卡兵器是斯巴達長矛：一根約兩米長的木槍，前端裝鐵矛頭，尾端套一枚銅套。它的任務從來不只是刺穿，而是讓整個方陣向前推移——前排以盾牌互相搭接成壁，後排用槍尾的銅套抵住前排的背，藉反力把整列人像攻城槌般推向前方。斯巴達與後來的底比斯、留克特拉之所以能贏，靠的就是這套把個人勇力換算成集體推力的辦法。到了555年，斯巴達長矛本身早已退場數百年：古典的裸體重裝步兵與青銅兵器被羅馬的長矛、以及後來拜占庭的長柄矛取代；哥特人使用包鐵的長矛，槍身修長，作雙手刺擊；兩翼的柏柏爾人與阿蘭弓騎兵則以複合反曲弓作為主要投射武器。步戰靠密集的圓盾與鎖子甲或皮甲，衝鋒時加戴護膝，配置與早期方陣重裝步兵幾乎相反：重步兵退居中軍，決定勝負的是弓弩的投射量與騎兵反擊的速度。因此斯巴達長矛在這場戰爭裡的位置不在裝備表上，而在準則上：帝國與哥特聯軍的中軍步兵仍是密集結陣、以盾牆頂住正面壓力，再由兩翼騎兵繞側或反擊。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Spartan dory: a wooden shaft about two metres long, fitted with an iron point and a bronze butt-spike. Its purpose was never simply to pierce, but to let the whole phalanx move forward. The front rank overlapped its shields into a wall while the rank behind braced its butt-spikes against the backs of the men in front, converting the recoil into a collective shove that pushed the formation along like a battering ram. This is why Sparta, and later Thebes at Leuctra, could win: the method turned individual bravery into collective pushing. By 555 the dory itself had been off the field for centuries. The classical naked heavy infantry and its bronze weapons were replaced by the Roman hasta and later by the Byzantine long spear, the kontos, while the Goths carried an iron-shod shaft, the framea, held in a two-handed thrust. The Berbers on the wings and the Alan mounted archers relied on the composite recurved bow as their chief missile weapon, and close combat favoured dense round shields with mail or leather armour and knee guards added when charging. That is nearly the opposite of the early hoplite picture: the heavy infantry fell back into the centre line, and the outcome was decided by the volume of arrows and the speed of the cavalry counterstroke. The dory's place in this war is therefore not on the inventory but in the doctrine: the infantry of both the imperial and the Gothic coalition still fought in close order, braced a shield wall against the pressure from the front, and left the flanks to the cavalry to encircle or counterstroke.
tactics: 瓜達萊特河畔的會戰決定了戰役走向。哥特與柏柏爾聯軍把哥特重步兵置於中軍、柏柏爾輕兵分列兩翼，準備用密集陣線正面推壓；帝國軍以步兵接戰、兩翼配置騎兵，並把精銳騎兵預備隊藏在陣後側翼。關鍵在一個投誠者的情報：一名帝國籍的軍官叛離後告訴哥特方面，帝國左翼薄弱，哥特聯軍遂猛攻那一側，一度突破；但突破之後縱隊散亂、隊形拉長，帝國騎兵預備隊由側翼反擊，插入渾散的步兵之中，柏柏爾人見勢先逃，帝國騎兵追擊殲滅，聯軍中軍至此瓦解。逃散的哥特人與柏柏爾人各自回營劫掠，後來在塞普提馬尼亞的山地裡以游擊方式抵抗帝國一年有餘，糧道被切斷才被迫北撤。554年帝國支持的貴族叛變中，雙方沒有再打會戰，帝國軍沿庇里牛斯山道推進、以海路封鎖港口，切斷南高盧城鎮的補給，最後以宴席上的刺殺收場。整套打法仍是希臘方陣的邏輯：正面以矛牆頂住、縱深靠方陣單位輪替、兩翼交由騎兵決定，只不過方陣裡的長矛已換成羅馬式鐵矛。
tacticsEn: The engagement on the Guadalete decided the campaign. The Gothic and Berber coalition put the Gothic heavy infantry in the centre with the lighter Berber troops on the wings, ready to press forward in a dense line, while the imperial army engaged with infantry, posted cavalry on both flanks and concealed its elite mounted reserve behind the line. The turning point was the intelligence of a defector: an officer of Roman origin who came over to the Goths told them the imperial left was weak, and the coalition stormed that side and broke through. But once through, the columns came apart and the line stretched, and the imperial mounted reserve counterstroked from the flank into the disordered infantry. The Berbers fled at the sight of it, the imperial cavalry pursued and destroyed them, and the centre of the coalition dissolved. The scattered Goths and Berbers went back to plunder their own camp, then carried on resistance in the hills of Septimania for more than a year, until their supply line was cut and they were forced north. In the noble revolt backed by the empire in 554 there was no second pitched battle: the imperial column advanced along the Pyrenean roads while the sea lanes were closed to cut the supply of the southern Gallic towns, and the affair was settled at a banquet. The underlying logic remains that of the Greek phalanx: the front held by a wall of spears, depth maintained by rotating units, the flanks entrusted to cavalry. Only the spear in the formation has changed, from the dory to the Roman iron-tipped shaft.
data: 可考的數字不多，但大致輪廓清楚。西哥特王國自418年在高盧南部立足，至555年最後一位國王去世，歷時約一百四十年；若連卡塔赫納一帶的殘餘哥特政權計算到約601年，則接近一百八十年，其間約有二十位君主更替。鼎盛期在埃烏里克王治下，版圖涵蓋伊比利亞半島大部與高盧南部，總面積約二十萬平方公里，是當時歐洲僅存的最大王國。瓜達萊特會戰雙方都不是大軍團作戰：帝國遠征軍規模在數千人量級，哥特與柏柏爾聯軍人數相近；戰後大批哥特殘部北逃，在塞普提馬尼亞的抵抗持續到554年。塞普提馬尼亞的淪陷歷時約一年（533至534年），卡爾卡松與納博訥相繼失守。555年之後帝國在西班尼亞的統治維持約一百五十六年，直到倭馬亞王朝的軍隊於711至718年之間攻陷南部與東部，718年之後整個半島脫離帝國。關於此役的主要史料是普羅科匹烏斯《戰爭史》第三卷、約爾丹尼斯《哥特史》，以及馬塞利努斯與伊西多爾的編年史。
dataEn: The record is thin, but the outline is clear. The Visigothic kingdom was established in southern Gaul in 418 and ended with the death of its last king in 555, a span of roughly one hundred and forty years; counting the rump Gothic regime at Cartagena down to about 601 brings it to nearly one hundred and eighty years, with about twenty rulers in between. At its height under King Euric it covered most of the Iberian peninsula and southern Gaul, an area of about two hundred thousand square kilometres, and was the largest surviving kingdom in Europe. Neither side at Guadalete fought as a mass army: the imperial expedition was in the order of a few thousand men, and the Gothic and Berber coalition was of comparable size; afterwards large numbers of Goths fled north and fought on in Septimania until 554. The fall of Septimania took about a year, from 533 to 534, with Carcassonne and Narbonne lost in turn. After 555 imperial rule in Hispania lasted about one hundred and fifty-six years, until the Umayyad forces took the south and the east between 711 and 718; after 718 the whole peninsula was out of the empire. The principal sources for the campaign are Procopius, Wars III, Jordanes, Getica, and the chronicles of Marcellinus and Isidore of Seville.
cause: 戰爭的起因並非單一事件，而是帝國政策、王室內鬥與宗教壓力三股力量的交會。查士丁尼自即位起就以恢復完整的羅馬世界為目標：不承認西歐存在獨立的日耳曼王國，認為只有帝國才配享有羅馬的普遍統治權。535年東哥特王國覆滅後，東哥特殘部與西哥特人合流，退入南高盧，使帝國無法安心經營北非的汪達爾前線；553年帝國在義大利獲勝後，壓力直接落到西哥特人頭上。戰略上，伊比利亞的金礦、糧食與通往北非的航路是帝國必爭之地，佔領西班牙等於在西地中海插入一把刀，羅馬舊日的西班尼亞省因此重新進入帝國的視野。內部則是王權與貴族的裂痕：幼王提奧德里克即位後，掌權的叔父與地方貴族各懷打算，552年阿塔納里克被推翻、部分貴族接受帝國金援，讓帝國得以用西班牙的哥特人對付南高盧的哥特人。宗教上，查士丁尼以正教立場施壓，並在554年以《敕令第十三》邀請哥特貴族接受羅馬頭銜、遷居君士坦丁堡。
causeEn: The war did not spring from a single event but from the meeting of imperial policy, dynastic conflict and religious pressure. From his accession Justinian aimed at a restored Roman world: he would not recognise an independent Germanic kingdom in the west, holding that only the empire was entitled to universal Roman rule. After the Ostrogothic kingdom collapsed in 535, Ostrogothic remnants joined the Visigoths in southern Gaul, and the empire could not settle its Vandal front in North Africa. Once the empire won in Italy in 553, the pressure fell directly on the Visigoths. Strategically the gold, the grain and the North African sea lanes of Iberia were prize assets, and holding Spain put a blade into the western Mediterranean, so the old Roman province of Hispania came back into imperial reckoning. Internally the fracture ran between crown and nobility: with the child king Theodoric on the throne, his uncles and the regional nobles pursued their own designs, Athanaric was overthrown in 552, and part of the nobility took imperial gold, allowing the empire to use Spanish Goths against the Goths of southern Gaul. Religiously Justinian pressed with the Chalcedonian position and in 554 offered the Gothic nobles Roman titles and settlement in Constantinople through Edict XIII.
impact: 西哥特王國的國家機器就此解體：官僚體系、土地登記、稅制與鑄幣權全部併入帝國，哥特貴族則被分批遷往君士坦丁堡，帝國以羅馬頭銜與軍職收編他們，其中不少人後來成為帝國的將軍與外交使節；赫魯利人與阿蘭人則被整批編入帝國軍隊，蠻族雇傭兵從此成為帝國制度的常備部分。西班尼亞隨即進入拜占庭的西班牙時代：南半部由帝國總督直接管治，稅收、鑄幣與稅關制度把伊比利亞重新接入地中海東西兩端的財政循環，直到七世紀末帝國失去西班牙為止。對更長遠的伊比利亞歷史而言，555年並非民族消失，而是政權中斷：西哥特與羅馬混血的居民繼續在原地生活，語言、法律記憶與貴族傳統延續，六世紀末卡塔赫納的殘餘哥特政權到約601年才被吸收，七世紀又由北方興起西哥特諸王國，於托萊多重建王權，埃沃里希與里卡雷德的統治最終把伊比利亞帶進中世紀西歐的版圖。對地中海世界而言，這場戰爭意味著羅馬的西界只剩下尚未被北方民族佔據的義大利與北非。
impactEn: The machinery of the Visigothic state came apart: the bureaucracy, the land registers, the taxation and the right to coin were absorbed into the empire, while the Gothic nobles were moved to Constantinople in groups and taken over through Roman titles and military commands, many of them later serving as imperial generals and ambassadors. The Heruli and the Alans were enrolled wholesale in the imperial army, and the employment of barbarian foederati became a standing institution of the empire. Hispania now entered the Byzantine Spanish age: the southern half was governed directly by an imperial governor, and taxation, coinage and the customs system tied Iberia back into the fiscal circuit running between the eastern and western Mediterranean, and that lasted until the empire lost Spain late in the seventh century. For the longer history of Iberia, 555 was not an ethnic disappearance but an interruption of government: Visigothic and Roman communities carried on living in place, language, legal memory and aristocratic tradition persisted, the rump Gothic regime at Cartagena was only absorbed around 601, and in the seventh century the Visigothic kingdoms of the north raised a kingship again at Toledo, where the line of Euric and Reccared eventually brought Iberia into the map of medieval western Europe. For the Mediterranean world, this war meant the western Roman frontier was reduced to Italy and North Africa, the last provinces not yet taken by the northern peoples.
result: 結果是西哥特王國在法律上終結。553年瓜達萊特一戰，聯軍崩潰，東哥特餘部在北非與高盧的殘餘勢力被清剿；554年帝國支持的貴族叛變雖一度奪回塞普提馬尼亞與南高盧，馬丁兄弟卻在555年被殺於卡爾卡松，末代王提奧德里克同年在同地去世，傳說死於查士丁尼使者的毒藥。西班尼亞自此由帝國接管，塞普提馬尼亞併回高盧行省，帝國另設軍事長官治理西班牙各郡，558年元旦起發行新鑄的索利都斯金幣。戰役留下幾個清楚的教訓：以重裝步兵方陣與騎兵協同，結合正面推壓與側翼反擊，仍是這個時代最有效的取勝辦法，斯巴達長矛代表的方陣邏輯並未過時；但真正決定這場戰爭的，是政治手段（收買叛貴、宮廷毒殺）、財政（稅收、鑄幣與艦隊補給）與戰略縱深，而非任何一件單兵器的性能。西哥特人沒有消失：其後裔留在伊比利亞，貴族成為帝國的將領，殘餘政權在東南延續到六世紀末，而西哥特之名在七世紀於北方重新興起。
resultEn: The outcome was the legal extinction of the Visigothic kingdom. The coalition broke at Guadalete in 553, and the Ostrogothic remnants in North Africa and Gaul were hunted down. The noble revolt backed by the empire in 554 briefly won back Septimania and southern Gaul, but Martin and his brothers were killed at Carcassonne in 555, and the last king Theodoric died in the same city the same year, reportedly by poison administered by Justinian's envoys. Hispania passed to the empire, Septimania was reabsorbed into the Gallic province, a military governor was installed over the Spanish districts, and newly struck solidus coinage was issued from the first of January 558. Several lessons stand out. Heavy infantry fighting in phalanx alongside cavalry, combining frontal pressure with a flank counterstroke, remained the surest way to win in this age, and the phalanx logic the dory stands for was not obsolete. What actually decided the war was political means, such as buying the rebel nobles and the poisoning in the palace, together with finance, that is taxation, coinage and the fleet that carried supply, and depth of strategy, not the performance of any single weapon. The Visigoths did not disappear: their descendants stayed in Iberia, their nobles became generals of the empire, the rump regime survived in the southeast to the end of the sixth century, and the name Visigoth returned to life in the north during the seventh.
